Notes
- All three font files are used unmodified, so the OFL reserved-name clause does not apply.
- Archivo-Variable.woff2 was downloaded into an empty directory before it was copied here: first four bytes `wOF2`, 90,096 bytes, SHA-256 4c98b9d490d1698ec95f2ff17a6c7d0e72691864c0c5d7bc2a2c161b45afe5ad. Its axes (read from the fvar table) are wght 100 to 900 and wdth 62 to 125; it has the tnum feature.
- No company logo, name or licensed typeface is used. The wordmark is set in B612 and the mark is drawn in inline SVG.
- Fonts are the Latin subsets (the unicode-range of the Google Fonts "latin" files). Both families include the minus sign (U+2212) and the no-break space (U+00A0). Spaces before % and units are U+00A0 (U+202F is in none of our fonts). The evidence marks for fact, assumption and fiction are drawn as SVG symbols, because neither font has the circle glyphs U+25CF, U+25D0 and U+25CB.
